directions.name: Afterhours
headline: Markets close.
Liquidity never sleeps.
directions.body: Market-aware liquidity for FX and tokenized assets. Define what happens when the reference market closes—and the on-chain market stays open.
directions.eyebrow: Sharper AMM LP. / FX + real-world assets
directions.influence: Ekubo’s focused opening; an original session instrument.
directions.thesis: Lead with the tension between market hours and an always-on token market.
pillars: A market close is a strategy input, not an afterthought.
Separate the token’s trading price from its external anchor.
Keep inventory, fees and operating costs in the same view.
directions.tradeoff: The strongest headline. It needs the session-policy note so “never sleeps” is not mistaken for guaranteed liquidity or uninterrupted trading.

directions.name: Mandate
headline: Liquidity shapes
markets.
directions.body: A euro market is not a tokenized stock market. Start with the asset, its reference and its trading session. Shape the liquidity around them.
directions.eyebrow: Sharper AMM LP. / Built around the asset
directions.influence: A concise issuer brief; concrete markets replace abstract product paragraphs.
directions.thesis: Help issuers recognize their asset before asking them to understand the architecture.
pillars: Place capital where the market needs it—not simply in the tightest ticks.
Set the assets you want to hold and the exposure you can accept.
Connect strategy, vault ownership and accountable operations.
directions.close: Which asset are you building for?
directions.tradeoff: The clearest buyer story. Illustrative asset names must not look like live listings or issuer partnerships.

directions.name: Reference
headline: One market.
Three signals.
A clear policy.
directions.body: Reference value. Market session. Inventory. Connect them to explicit liquidity instructions, with strategy separate from on-chain custody and accounting.
directions.eyebrow: Sharper AMM LP. / Reference → policy → liquidity
directions.influence: Five North’s annotated engineering language; original Pairs.pro system geometry.
directions.thesis: Make session-aware market design tangible through a single readable engineering drawing.
pillars: Identify the source, quote currency and freshness rules.
Define open, closed and stale-input behavior before capital moves.
Apply an exposure policy; a reference price is not a guaranteed exit.
directions.tradeoff: The strongest diligence story. Keep the diagram legible on mobile and avoid implying the session-aware design is already deployed.

references.use: Focus, concise proposition and clear action; no assets or claims copied.
Annotated engineering relationships; original Pairs.pro drawing.

examples: EUR/USD, Tesla-linked and Nvidia-linked tokens are illustrative, not listings or affiliations.
capabilityBoundary: Session-aware/external-reference policies are design scope, not a claim of deployed behavior. HOLD stops new instructions, not existing exposure.
scope: Static presentation only. No strategy, contract, execution or custody changes.
